summary: Raven Software's Hexen branch builds on Heretic's Doom-engine lineage with hub-based dark fantasy shooting, character classes, inventory use, and later enhanced-release preservation.

entries.title: Hexen: Beyond Heretic
entries.definitive_edition: Heretic + Hexen enhanced release on PC, with original DOS/source-port comparison labeled if used

emulation.notes: Use the enhanced PC release for current access; use original IWAD/source-port only when exact historical behavior matters.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current enhanced release plus labeled original route comparison

primary.version: Heretic + Hexen enhanced release with original/enhanced mode documented
primary.why: The 2025 Heretic + Hexen release is the current official route, bundling Hexen: Beyond Heretic, Deathkings, modern accessibility, multiplayer, and new content. The original DOS IWAD/source-port route remains important for exact 1995 behavior.
primary.how_to_play: Use Heretic + Hexen on PC for the main route. Record build/storefront, original versus enhanced soundtrack/gameplay options, episode/hub, character class, difficulty, mod state, multiplayer state, and whether a DOS/source-port original was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original timing, renderer, and source-port behavior
secondary.why: The enhanced release is current and complete, but changes presentation and adds new material.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record whether new episodes, enhanced soundtrack, accessibility, and gameplay toggles are enabled.

entries.title: Heretic
entries.definitive_edition: Heretic + Hexen enhanced rerelease for current play; DOS Shadow of the Serpent Riders for historical comparison

emulation.emulator: Enhanced rerelease wrapper for primary; DOSBox/source ports only for comparison
emulation.notes: Use the current official rerelease unless exact DOS behavior is required.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Heretic + Hexen enhanced PC route or original DOS for historical fidelity

primary.version: Heretic + Hexen enhanced rerelease, Heretic route
primary.why: The current Heretic + Hexen release is the best official route for Heretic today, bundling the classic game with the Serpent Riders content and new enhanced-release features. Original DOS/Shadow of the Serpent Riders remains the historical comparison route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Heretic campaign in Heretic + Hexen on PC. Record build, renderer, resolution/FPS, original/enhanced soundtrack state, difficulty, episode, new episode inclusion, mods/add-ons, multiplayer state, and whether original DOS was compared.

secondary.platform: MS-DOS / Heretic: Shadow of the Serpent Riders
secondary.exclusive_content: Original DOS runtime and historical expansion route
secondary.what_to_play: Use if preserving exact 1994/1996 DOS behavior.
secondary.why: The enhanced rerelease is the current route, but DOS is the historical source artifact.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record renderer, soundtrack, mod/add-on, and new episode state; do not merge Heretic completion with Hexen completion.
